transcript:
User: Hey. Got something in the mail about missed calls?
Agent: Hey there, you did! I’m Linda with Dialux. Thanks for calling in.  

Yeah, that mailer was about helping small businesses stop losing leads to missed calls and after-hours voicemails.  

What kind of business are you running, and what’s been going on with your calls lately? Are you feeling like you’re missing a lot, or just starting to notice it?
User: Already told ya - me and my sister run Bright Smile Orthodontics, and our front desk keeps missing calls.
Agent: Got it, Bright Smile Orthodontics with you and your sister—that sounds like a busy front desk for sure.

I don’t think I caught your name though—what should I call you? And are you mostly missing calls during certain times (like lunch, after school rush, or after hours), or is it kind of all day?
User: Already told ya - Dana Whitaker. Missing calls throughout the day.
Agent: Thanks, Dana. And yeah, when it’s all day, that’s extra frustrating.

When people do get through, what are they usually calling about—new patient consults, rescheduling, payment questions, emergencies? That helps me picture what kind of calls you’re most worried about missing.
User: Hm, hadn't thought about it - whatever works for you guys.
Agent: Totally fair answer.

So I don’t lose track, let me grab a couple basics for my notes.  
What’s the best email for you if we need to send over details?
User: Already told ya - email's dana@brightsmileortho.com.
Agent: Perfect, thanks for confirming that, Dana.

And if we ever get disconnected or need to follow up, what number should we call you back on?
User: Already told ya - my cell is four eight zero, five five five, oh one seven seven.
Agent: Got it, thanks.

Is that cell the best number for you if our team needs to reach you later, or do you prefer a different one?
Agent: Just to confirm, Dana—should I mark that 480 cell as your best number, or is there another one you’d rather we use?
User: Already told ya - that's the best number.
Agent: Perfect, I’ll mark that.

And are you in the Phoenix area, Dana? I just want to make sure I’ve got your time zone right so we don’t bug you at the wrong hour.
User: Already told ya - we're Arizona, so like Mountain time I guess?
Agent: Arizona, got it—America/Phoenix time, no weird daylight savings.

Last thing I need: what time of day is usually best for someone from our team to catch you? Morning, lunchtime, later afternoon?
User: Already told ya - mornings before my first patient are really the only good window.
Agent: Oh, sorry—just to double-check, Dana: you said you’re in Arizona on Phoenix time, right?
User: Yep.
Agent: Thanks, Dana. I’ve got everything I need here. Your dedicated Dialux specialist will give you a call in the morning before your first patient, Phoenix time, to walk you through how we can help catch those missed calls at Bright Smile Orthodontics. Have a great rest of your day!
